title: From Cauchy to Gaussian: Sharp Lower Deviations and Ehrhard-Type Inequality
summary: We establish dimension-free, pointwise optimal lower-deviation bounds for convex functions under spherically symmetric Cauchy-type measures. These bounds use either mean-variance normalization or moments about the median, the latter covering the Cauchy case where the mean and variance are unavailable. By approximation with a parametrized family the Cauchy-type measures, our results recover the Gaussian setting of Paouris and Valettas \cite{PaourisValettas18} and strengthen their variance-sensitive estimate to a sharp bound, with a complete equality characterization.
